prose: AI Passport Photo is a web tool for producing passport and visa photos with AI. The flow starts by choosing a country and document template; the tool then applies the matching frame, background color, and head-size guide from that specification. The cached source was only this first step, so this summary reflects the tool's documented onboarding rather than its full feature set.
highlights: Web tool that produces passport/visa photos with AI
Step 1: pick a country and document template
Applies the spec's frame, background color, and head-size guide automatically
